summary_en: 50,000 shares (3.84% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired for up to ¥400M via open-market purchase on TSE Standard Market from June 16, 2026 to May 31, 2027. Purpose: shareholder returns and capital efficiency. Funded from existing cash.
title_en: Notice regarding the decision of matters concerning acquisition of treasury shares (acquisition of treasury shares based on Articles of Incorporation pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: Kyowa Kogyosyo announced on June 15, 2026 that its board has authorized acquisition of up to 50,000 of its own common shares (3.84% of the 1,301,520 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for up to ¥400M. The repurchase will be executed via open-market purchase on the TSE Standard Market from June 16, 2026 through May 31, 2027. The stated purpose is to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency. The acquisition will be funded from the company's existing cash reserves. At the authorization date, the company held 58,480 treasury shares.
